cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. My forecast said sunny. Clearly I meant your reaction to the refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The holiday was ruined by rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Which created the refund and your brightened outlook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A symbol of optimism. You must read the whole prediction generously.
